content.overview: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS), Act 46 of 2023, is the current general criminal-procedure statute for proceedings governed by the post-1 July 2024 regime. Its central design is sequential: information, investigation, judicial scrutiny, charge, trial, judgment and remedies, with constitutional liberty and the s. 531 savings rule controlling the transition from the CrPC.
